evals.prompt: I just built this Next.js task board app and I have zero tests. Can you set up testing and write tests for the critical stuff?
evals.expected_output: Detects stack, installs ecosystem, audits with P0-P3 labels, writes tests weighted toward error paths, runs them, and does mutation testing on critical code
expectations: Correctly identifies the stack as Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Prisma, Zod
Output contains explicit P0, P1, P2 priority labels with blast-radius reasoning
Installs test runner and produces working test configuration
Writes tests for the API route covering both GET and POST
Error/edge-case tests outnumber happy-path tests for P0 code (count them — more sad-path than happy-path assertions)
Tests are actually executed (transcript shows test runner output or explicit statement about running tests)
Mutation testing is performed: at least one intentional code break is introduced and verified that tests catch it
Report includes error-path vs happy-path ratio
Report includes a Remaining Gaps section with specific items
Report includes How to Run section with actual commands
